name: Tag List
tagline: A multi-select lookup for model-driven forms: related records as chips, with a type-ahead to attach more.

limitations: The demo's Dataverse is the preset's fixture, held in the browser: an account with a native many-to-many to a table of 24 tags, and a lookup from tag to account as well. Search, linking, unlinking and creating go through the same Web API calls and $ref requests a form sends, answered from that fixture; nothing is saved, and Reset or a reload puts it back.
Browse opens the demo's own lookup dialog, a searchable list of the tag table. The platform's dialog also offers views and columns, which the demo's does not.
Opening a tag reports it through the Selected tag output and navigates nowhere. On a form it opens the tag's record.
A refused request, such as a user missing the Append privilege, cannot be shown: the demo's Dataverse grants everything. The refusal line is in the screenshots.

presets.name: Many-to-many
presets.description: An account with six tags from a shared vocabulary of 24. Type to find more (try "re"), pick one to link it, or type a new name to create it. The magnifier browses the whole table. The × unlinks a tag; the tag itself stays and can be found again.

presets.name: Curated vocabulary
presets.description: Allow new tags off: the box attaches existing tags only, and a name that matches nothing offers no Create.

presets.name: More tags than fit
presets.description: Max visible at 3, so the rest collapse into +3 more until expanded.

presets.name: More than one relationship
presets.description: Relationship name left blank. The two tables are joined by a many-to-many and by a lookup, so the control shows the chips, no add box, and the two names to choose from — what a maker sees before configuring it.
